question: BIFR was set up in 1987. The full form of BIFR is:

options.text: Board for Industrial and Financial Reconstruction
Bank for Industrial and Financial Repatriation
Bank of Industrial and Financial Reconstruction
Board for Industry and Foreign Repatriation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Board for Industrial and Financial Reconstruction.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **Board **for Industrial and **Financial Reconstruction **is the full name of **BIFR**.
 
• It was established under the **Sick Industrial Companies Act **of **1985 **and is a department of the **Ministry of Finance's Department of Financial Services.**
 
• Its goal was to **revamp **and **salvage troubled projects **and to prevent or end the long-term growth and occurrence of troubled performances.
 
• **Goals **of the **BIFR**:
 
 
• A **chairperson **and two to **fourteen **other representatives made up the BIFR.
 
• The requirements for membership were being elected **High Court judges **or having at least **15 years **of professional experience. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• In the years before **independence**, industrial illness first appeared in India.
 
• In the beginning, the **Indian government **made an effort to stop it by using **ad-hock** processes that involved **nationalising **banks to offer **temporary **support.
 
• In **1981**, the **Tiwari Committee **was established, and it put out **comprehensive legislation **to address industrial illness.
 
• As a result, **SICA **was established in **1985**, and **BIFR **was established as part of **SICA **in **January 1987.**
 
• In **April 1987**, the **Appellate Authority **for **Industrial **and **Financial Reconstruction **(AAIFR) was established.
 
• Government companies were adopted in **1991**, with the help of **SICA**.
 
• Following that, cases of **occupational illness **in both **public **and **private **organisations were covered.
